duration.details: As long as the temp HP granted by this spell remains (max. 10 minutes)

description.baseEffect:
Tier 9 · 5 Actions.

Transform into a Huge Dragon. Gain 3 Actions, 16 flying speed, LVL Armor, 10×LVL temp HP, and:

  • Tooth & Claw (1 Action). Reach: 2, Damage: 2d10+LVL. Inflicts Smoldering. Ignores armor.
  • Immolating Breath (2 Actions). Cone: 6, Damage: KEY d10 damage on failed DEX save, half on save. Smoldering targets automatically fail.

You can maintain this form for as long as the temp HP granted by this spell remains (max. 10 minutes). When it ends, you drop to 0 HP.
